description: Immutable governance constraints for SPS-CA (Layer 1: Software DNA). Hard rules must reject a violating action outright. Soft rules are logged as warnings. This file is read-only at runtime; only a human-reviewed pull request may change it.

dna_rules.constraint: Never modify core governance logic or the DNA rule set itself
dna_rules.rationale: The rules that constrain self-modification cannot be a target of self-modification, or the entire governance layer is meaningless.

dna_rules.constraint: Never bypass or disable the Governance layer's approval gate for an Evolution-generated capability
dna_rules.rationale: Every self-generated capability must pass through explicit governance review before activation.

dna_rules.constraint: Never bypass or disable the Validation layer for a proposed change
dna_rules.rationale: Untested self-modifications must not reach execution.

dna_rules.constraint: Never execute a capability outside the sandbox/controlled execution environment
dna_rules.rationale: Generated code must run in an isolated environment until proven safe.

dna_rules.constraint: Never delete or overwrite experience logs, audit trails, or lineage records
dna_rules.rationale: The audit trail is the evidentiary basis for the thesis claims (traceability, reversibility). It must be append-only.

dna_rules.constraint: Never commit secrets, API keys, tokens, or credentials to the repository
dna_rules.rationale: Matches REQUIREMENTS.md: 'Never commit API keys, tokens, passwords, or other secrets to the repository.'

dna_rules.constraint: Never apply a self-modification without a rollback path
dna_rules.rationale: Every change to SPS-CA's own logic must be reversible (Layer 10: Execution snapshots).

dna_rules.constraint: Never modify a user's target project files without an explicit user request for that project
dna_rules.rationale: SPS self-change (Type B) and user-project change must remain distinct; SPS-CA must not silently touch user code.

dna_rules.constraint: Prefer the smallest capability version bump that accurately reflects the change
dna_rules.rationale: Keeps capability lineage and version history meaningful rather than inflated.

dna_rules.constraint: Prefer reusing or adapting an existing capability over generating a new one when semantically equivalent
dna_rules.rationale: Reduces capability sprawl; supports the meta-learning/adaptation research questions.

dna_rules.constraint: Flag any generated capability whose target languages fall outside the supported set (Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, C#) for manual review
dna_rules.rationale: The evaluation is scoped to five target languages; anything outside that scope needs explicit sign-off.

dna_rules.constraint: Log every DNA check performed, whether it passes or fails
dna_rules.rationale: Supports the auditability claim even for actions that were ultimately allowed.
